'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|No shortage of patriots... I had a conversation with a group of BEARs the other day, we chatted about domestic weapons. Always nice to meet people who know their stuff!Just got a brand-new Kalashnikov in, and it needs a proper field test... Hmm, maybe somewhere with a mix of urban and open terrain? Yeah, that would be perfect. Here's the build. Go put it through its paces.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 10 PMCs with [[AK-12]] with [[AK-12 5.45x39 sound suppressor|proprietary suppressor]] and [[Valday PS-320 1/6x scope|PS-320 scope]] on [[Streets of Tarkov]], [[Shoreline]], or [[Ground Zero]]

==Guide==
Only the [[AK-12 5.45x39 sound suppressor]] can be used. It's possible to use a compact reflex sight mounted on a [[NcSTAR MPR45 Backup mount|canted rail]] instead of the [[Valday PS-320 1/6x scope]] to obtain the kills. The scope just needs to be installed to count towards the quest.
